The text describes a cybersecurity policy where standard user accounts are restricted from having administrator privileges. This is a standard security practice known as the principle of least privilege, which helps prevent unauthorized changes to system settings or software installations. Users are required to submit a formal request to the IT department for such changes, ensuring that all modifications are tracked and authorized. This approach enhances security by minimizing the risk of accidental or malicious system alterations.

The first three months of the year are January, February, and March.
